summary: Iteration 4 is a frontend-only cyberpunk redesign of the operator dashboard. Ran a full Playwright UI regression against the public URL (https://traffic-to-account.preview.emergentagent.com). All 11 requested check groups passed: no CRA compile overlay, all data-testids resolve with live API values, pill reads '[ SYSTEM ONLINE ]', username '@TAMIL_BEST_SERVICE_BOT' + blinking cursor, copy button toggles COPY→COPIED→COPY (~1.8s), /api/bot/status polls repeat every 15s (observed 2→3 calls across 17s), the 500-mock offline path flips the pill to '[ LINK DOWN ]' without crashing, ad-url-value equals REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + '/api/r?click_id={click_id}', at 1920px the right vertical rail is visible and stats sit in one row, at 390px the rail is hidden and stats stack vertically with no horizontal overflow, Tamil 'தமிழ்' renders in the footer with non-zero width (89x15, no tofu), and the copy button shows a cyan focus ring. Backend regression not re-run per request (frontend-only iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 34: prev.current is mutated inside the effect before the cleanup runs, which is fine for this hook but slightly non-idiomatic — moving the assignment out of the branch or into a ref-update effect would be cleaner. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. No writes performed. Only GETs to /api/bot/status and one intercepted 500 mock (client-side only via page.route).
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI is stable. Live API showed total_starts=22, unique_users=2, starts_today=22, postbacks_sent=2, starts_attributed=3 at test time — user's real production data has grown since iteration 3 (was 1/20). Do NOT delete bot_events/bot_postbacks. Polling interval is 15s; offline state was verified via page.route interception returning 500. Focus ring uses ring-1 ring-cyan-500 (rgb 6,182,212). The only console noise observed was the two expected 500s from the intentional offline-state test.
